definitions.CPR_REV: resistance touch+close below PDH/R1/R2 or support touch+close above PDL/S1/S2
definitions.CPR_BRK: completed close crosses TC/PP/BC, PDH/PDL, R1/R2/S1/S2; direction follows break
definitions.SMA20/SMA50: close crosses its simple moving average
definitions.RSI: Wilder RSI14 crosses 55 bull / 45 bear; confirmation state neutral between 45 and 55
definitions.confirmation: other-source direction states at signal close; each candidate source excluded; CPR state uses above/below CPR/PP; entry at next open, 0.5% SL, 2% target, cutoff 15:00, EOD 15:20
definitions.labels: adverse move under 30 points counts labeled WIN; raw-positive rate separately; net R subtracts estimated 0.10R per trade
